description: A subscribe-to-updates button that rings the bell when switched on, sends out ripple rings and swaps its text with a crossfade; it also has a notification-count badge.
interactionNotes: Clicking or pressing `Space`/`Enter` toggles the state: the bell shakes several times, two ring waves radiate from each side, and the button text changes with a crossfade and a gradual reveal. The button widens or narrows to fit the new text, and the count badge is visible only in the on state.

props.icon: Custom icon; if omitted, the default bell.
props.label: Extra accessible name.
props.color: Text and icon color in the off state.
props.background: Button surface in the off state.
props.onColor: Text and icon color in the on state.
props.onBackground: Button surface in the on state.
props.size: Size of the button, icon and text.
props.ringAmplitude: Amplitude of the bell's shake, degrees.
props.ringDecay: Rate at which the shake fades out.
props.ringDuration: Total duration of the shake, milliseconds.
props.ringPivot: Hinge point, as a percentage of the icon height from the top.
props.crossfadeMs: Duration of the text crossfade, milliseconds.
props.revealBounce: Spring bounce on switching on, 0 to 1.
props.count: Number of unread notifications; visible only in the on state.
props.badge: Whether the count badge is shown.
props.clapper: An outline bell with a clapper instead of a solid icon.

tips: The icon is the button's first child, so under `dir="rtl"` it settles on the right on its own and the text on the left — exactly the intended layout, without `order`.
In RTL the badge moves toward the text (left), because it is positioned with `inset-inline-end`; if you have placed it manually, in Persian it sticks to the icon's edge and overlaps it.

Supply `count` from your own data source (for example the number of unread notifications); in the site demo, so that the badge is visible in the on state, it has a manual slider and also an automatic timer.
Reduce `ringAmplitude` and `ringPasses` if the button repeats in a busy list; a full five-pass shake grabs attention at first glance but across ten buttons it creates clutter.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` the shake and waves are removed and the text crossfade is shortened; the on/off state is read from color and text.
